recognize_zh: 核型式為 46,XY,t(3;3)(q21;q26.2),t(9;22)(q34;q11.2)：箭頭標示 der(9)、縮短的 der(22)（費城染色體）與兩條重排的 3 號染色體；間期 FISH 以 BCR（綠）/ABL1（紅）探針可見黃色融合訊號，確認 BCR::ABL1。
features: Arrows mark der(9), the shortened der(22) (Philadelphia chromosome), and both rearranged chromosome 3 homologs
Partial karyotype inset pairs normal 9 and 22 with their derivatives
Interphase FISH (BCR green, ABL1 red): yellow fusion signals indicating BCR::ABL1
Additional t(3;3) places MECOM (EVI1) near RPN1 enhancer, an adverse secondary change
describe_en: This composite is a non-morphologic cytogenetic figure. The G-banded karyotype shows 46,XY,t(3;3)(q21;q26.2),t(9;22)(q34;q11.2), with the Philadelphia chromosome [der(22)] and der(9) indicated along with rearranged chromosome 3 homologs. Interphase dual-color FISH with BCR (green) and ABL1 (red) probes demonstrates fused yellow signals in both nuclei, confirming BCR::ABL1. The coexisting t(3;3)(q21;q26.2), which juxtaposes MECOM with RPN1, is a high-risk additional chromosomal abnormality associated with blast phase, TKI resistance, and poor prognosis in CML.

ddx.vs: Carries the same t(9;22) (often p190 BCR::ABL1), so distinction relies on marrow morphology/flow and history rather than the karyotype alone.
Shows the MECOM rearrangement but no Philadelphia chromosome and no BCR::ABL1 fusion signals on FISH.
Complex or cryptic variants may lack a visible der(22) on G-banding but still show BCR::ABL1 fusion by FISH or RT-PCR.
